access.notes: Open-source DFT package. Use a recent version (≥6.7) supporting hybrid functionals and finite-field / Berry-phase calculations.
Standard solid-state pseudopotentials for Si, C, Mg, O (e.g., SSSP precision 1.1 or PSLibrary).
Publicly known: Si (diamond cubic, a=5.43 Å), C (diamond cubic, a=3.57 Å), MgO (rocksalt, a=4.21 Å). Obtainable from standard references or databases (e.g., Crystallography Open Database).
